gloss: foil; supporting role that makes others look better

definitions.gloss: foil; person or thing that makes another look better by contrast
definitions.explanation: A person, character, or element whose purpose is to highlight or enhance the qualities of another, often the main figure. Equivalent to a 'foil' or 'straight man' in English.

examples.japanese: いつも{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}にされる。
examples.english: I always end up being the foil.

examples.japanese: {脇役|わきやく}は{主役|しゅやく}の{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}だ。
examples.english: The supporting actor is a foil for the lead.

examples.japanese: シンプルなドレスが{彼女|かのじょ}のアクセサリーの{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}になっている。
examples.english: The simple dress serves as a foil to highlight her accessories.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく} comes from {引|ひ}き{立|た}てる (to make something stand out) + {役|やく} (role). It can refer to people, characters, or even objects that enhance something else by contrast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}になる — to become a foil
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}にされる — to be made into a foil (passive, slightly negative)
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}て{役|やく}に{回|まわ}る — to take on the foil role

RELATED WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}てる — to make something stand out
- {脇役|わきやく} — supporting role
- {主役|しゅやく} — lead role
